# C383 (inline) — dry-run replays must not write production catalog
2026-10-21: catalog had 9 auction_stock_facts + 9 auction_panorama versions for 10-21, 8 created by gate/builder replays (run_daily_reports --dry-run) because daily_pipeline stored them under default CORE_DATA_ROOT with available_at=now. Fix: dry_run stores under <out_root>/.dry_run_artifacts. Verified: production catalog per-dataset version counts identical before/after both gate replays.
